summary: Master Regulatory Impact Assessment with practical tools, templates, and decision briefs. Evaluate options, consultation, and monitoring with confidence.
lede: Regulatory impact assessment helps policy, compliance, regulatory and legal professionals evaluate proposed rules by defining the problem and comparing options. Designed for practitioners, managers, specialists and advisers, the training develops a workflow for producing evidence-based assessments, including baseline evidence mapping, cost-benefit and multi-criteria option analysis, stakeholder consultation planning, burden and feasibility appraisal, and monitoring scorecards and decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work with policy, compliance, regulation, or impact analysis and need a stronger RIA workflow. It is suitable for practitioners, managers, specialists, and advisers who must turn regulatory proposals into structured evidence, consultation records, and decision briefs. Regulatory affairs officers who assess proposal impacts and compliance burden. Policy analysts who prepare RIA notes and option appraisals. Compliance managers who review rule changes and control implications. Legal and policy advisers who support regulatory drafting and consultation. Public sector economists who estimate costs, benefits, and distributional effects. Risk analysts who connect regulation to operational and control risk. Government relations specialists who manage consultation responses. Strategy managers who align regulation with business or public outcomes. Program managers who track implementation and evaluation plans. Sector association advisers who brief members on proposed regulatory changes.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and familiarity with your organization’s policy, compliance, or regulatory documents. Participants benefit most if they can reference a current or recent regulation, proposal, consultation note, or internal policy review during the exercises.
